stock.tax_explained:
Tax bracket of the product, e.g., 13.8%.

Italian legislation taxes Bonds at 12.5% and Stocks at 26%.
Products like Money Market ETFs, which may be built with a mix of underlying assets, are then taxed accordingly.

Example: XEON, swap-based, 90% bonds, 10% stocks:
    ⦁ 12.5*0.90 + 26*0.10 = 13.85%

The underlying proportions should be disclosed by the product Issuer and updated every six months.

split.title: Shares Split
split.descr:
If an asset's price is too low or too high, the issuer may decide to apply a split.
N-to-1 split: 1 share is divided into N shares.
1-to-N reverse split: N shares are grouped into 1.
In both cases, splits do not alter the value of your investment.

The application auto detects splits during a Home page refresh. If auto detection fails, this option lets you manually record a split.
split.ratio_descr:
4:1 split (1 share becomes 4): ratio = 4

1:10 split (10 shares become 1): ratio = 0.1
